- With a low glycemic index, it’s a better option for mindful eating.

body_html:
The Two Brothers Forest Honey is wild honey and hence, each batch can have a different taste and texture. The bee boxes are placed in deep forest regions. Bees of Apis Cerana Indica species have used nectar from a variety of flowers to make this honey!

It is single strained to retain maximum pollen and natural nutrients. It is not artificially flavoured or infused.

This Wild Multifloral honey is made by the native Indian bee species Apis Cerana Indica (also known as Sateri Maashi locally) and not using the widely popular European imported bees, Apis Mellifera; widely popular and preferred by many beekeepers because the European Mellifera colonies can produce anywhere between 20-40 kg of honey per colony per year, while the yield is far lower with native Indian bees like the Cerana Indica; about 8-10 kg yield per colony per year.

title: Desi Gir Cow Cultured Ghee
body_html:

Crafted from the milk of free-grazed, pasture-raised Gir cows.

Our process starts with choosing the right cattle feed that's not sprayed with dangerous weedicides containing glyphosate. Then, we take the milk, carefully turn it into yogurt using a natural starter culture and set it overnight. In the stillness of the early morning, the yogurt is then churned using the Bilona method - clockwise and anticlockwise to separate the raw white butter. This butter is then gently simmered to create a rich, golden ghee.

Made daily in small batches and certified glyphosate free by The detox project, our Desi Gir Cow Cultured Ghee contains no additives, preservatives, chemicals or artificial ingredients.
